'''Ceri''' is a servant of some kind at the Lady [[Arilyn Dhulaine]]'s palace in [[Cairhien]].

When [[Egwene]] spies on the Lady Arilyn's house, she listens to the servants' gossip. Among other things, they say that Ceri is having a baby.
